digest.component_or_area: MCP model layer and schema code generation
propositions: _mcp_models.py hand-mirrors five committed JSON schemas as pydantic models without a drift gate or generator, causing schema divergence to ship undetected.

BridgeFsckOut declares three properties but its schema bridge_fsck.schema.json has four; binding_drift is missing from the model but emitted by _engine_support/bridge_fsck.py:217 and present in types.py:311.
VerifySignatureResultOut makes algorithm, head_sha, and key_id optional in the model while the schema requires all three.
The comment at _mcp_models.py:31-34 falsely claims cross-interface schema tests pin the models to schemas, but no such tests exist for BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, or WorkflowRunOut.
The TypedDict layer uses schemas/gen_types.py with --check enforcement in CI, but the MCP model layer lacks equivalent generation or drift-gate coverage.
